common.language.label.note: Label on the language control, in the user menu and on the pre-login screens.

common.language.choose.note: Accessible name of the language control (FR-LOC-001a, IAM-010g). Reachable before login, so it must make sense with no account context around it.

common.language.name.nl.note: The endonym. A language is named in its own language in a language picker, so that someone who cannot read the current UI language can still find their own.

common.skip_to_content.note: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.1 (Bypass Blocks). The first focusable element on the page, visible only while focused - it lets a keyboard user step over the header and navigation straight to the screen's content.

common.theme.label.note: Accessible name of the light/dark control (ADR-055). A radiogroup of three, so the group needs its own name separate from the three option labels below.

common.theme.system.note: The default: follow whatever the device is set to, including when the device changes it at sunset. Not the same as explicitly picking the theme the device happens to be in right now.

common.nav.label.note: Accessible name of the desktop rail (the shell's main navigation).

common.nav.ledger.note: Kept Dutch in the English UI per glossary.json's grootboek entry.

common.nav.clients.note: A firm's client administrations (FR-ONB-001b) — distinct from an administration's own customers (common.nav.customers).

common.nav.group.bookkeeping.note: The one heading over the rail's nine sections, from the Boekje design (Boekhouding / Bookkeeping).

common.nav.dashboard.note: The first rail item: the dashboard at '/'. 'Overview' is taken by the purchases list (common.nav.overview), which the rail labels common.nav.purchases_all so the two never share a name.

common.nav.purchases_all.note: The purchases list ('/overview'), as the last item under Purchases.

common.nav.journal.note: Memoriaal: journal entries that come from neither a purchase, a sale nor the bank.

common.nav.assets.note: MVA is materiële vaste activa, the Dutch term for fixed assets.

common.soon.title.note: Heading of the placeholder a rail item opens while its screen is not built.

common.soon.body.note: {section} is the rail item's own name. Says plainly that the screen is not built rather than showing an empty one.
common.soon.body.nl: Het scherm {section} is nog niet gebouwd. Zodra het er is, vind je het hier.
common.soon.body.en: The {section} screen has not been built yet. When it is, you will find it here.

common.user_menu.open.note: Accessible name of the avatar button that opens the user menu.

common.search.shortcut.note: The keyboard chord shown in the search field; a key name, not a word.

common.search.hint.en: ↑ ↓ to choose · Enter to open · Esc to close

common.verification.banner.note: IAM-010b: shown in the shell until the address is verified. Says what is blocked (posting) and what to do.
common.verification.banner.nl: Bevestig uw e-mailadres via de link die we naar {email} hebben gestuurd. Tot die tijd kunt u alles voorbereiden, maar nog niets boeken.
common.verification.banner.en: Verify your email address using the link we sent to {email}. Until then you can prepare everything, but not post to the books yet.

common.verification.resent.en: Sent. Check your spam folder too.

common.error.next_step.note: D5: every error says what to do next. The specific sentence above it is the server's; this is the generic next step.
common.error.next_step.nl: Probeer het opnieuw. Blijft het misgaan, controleer dan uw verbinding of probeer het later nog eens.
common.error.next_step.en: Try again. If it keeps failing, check your connection or try again later.

common.not_found.body.nl: Het adres klopt niet, of de pagina is verplaatst. Ga terug naar het overzicht.
common.not_found.body.en: The address is wrong, or the page has moved. Go back to the overview.

common.session.load_failed_hint.nl: Uw account kon niet worden geladen. Lukt het na een nieuwe poging nog niet, log dan uit en weer in.
common.session.load_failed_hint.en: Your account could not be loaded. If it still fails after retrying, sign out and back in.
